newsitem.title: USA: Peerless Industrial completes sale plan.
newsitem.headline: Peerless Industrial completes sale plan.

text.p: Peerless Industrial Group Inc, a holding company that owns a chain manufacturer, said Wednesday it has completed negotiations for sale of control of Peerless to R-B Capital Corp.
About 97 percent of Peerless shares were tendered and not withdrawn in a tender offer that expired May 15, Peerless said.

As the final step of the acquisition, Peerless will be merged with a unit of R-B Capital, Peerless said, adding that since R-B Capital owns more than 90 percent of the outstanding stock of Peerless, this will be accomplished by a short-form merger without a meeting of the other Peerless shareholders.
Under the terms of the definitive merger agreement with Peerless, R-B Capital will pay $1.67 a share for each of the shares of Peerless that were not purchased in the tender offer, Peerless said.
